check.population: every import, package and service boundary the style's dependency rules range over
check.freshness: a verdict stands until an import, a package boundary or a deployment unit changes
check.refusal: the layer or dependency rule fails the build on an edge the style forbids
check.observation: the import graph and the deployment topology, read from source and configuration
check.evidence: none: the catalog states this check as a class, so a watched run belongs to each system that adopts it
check.authority: the style's declared dependency rules, which every import and deployment edge conforms to

distinctFrom.reason: Ports and adapters isolates the core behind ports, while clean architecture arranges concentric layers whose dependencies point inward.

records.name: Ports and Adapters Architecture
records.definition: A convention of keeping a domain core free of framework and data types, with every external dependency behind a port the application owns and implemented by an adapter outside it.

records.name: Clean Architecture
records.definition: A convention of concentric layers in which source dependencies point only inward, towards the use cases and entities.

records.name: Layered Architecture
records.definition: A convention of stacking presentation, application and persistence layers, each calling only the layer below it.

records.name: Component-Based Architecture
records.definition: A convention of building a system from components that declare what they export and what they require.

records.name: Package by Feature
records.definition: A design rule that code is grouped by the feature it serves, so one change stays inside one package.
detected_by: change sets spanning many layer packages

exemplar.before:
src/controllers/foo.ts
src/controllers/bar.ts
src/services/foo.ts
src/services/bar.ts
src/repositories/foo.ts
src/repositories/bar.ts
exemplar.after:
src/foo/controller.ts
src/foo/service.ts
src/foo/repository.ts
src/bar/controller.ts
src/bar/service.ts
src/bar/repository.ts

records.name: Microservices
records.definition: A convention of splitting a system into services that each own their data and deploy independently.

records.name: Monolith Architecture
records.definition: A convention of deploying a system as one unit, with its modules kept apart by internal boundaries.

records.name: Pipes and Filters
records.definition: A convention of processing data through independent stages that share one input and output interface.

records.name: Service-Oriented Architecture
records.definition: A convention of exposing each business capability as a service governed by a published contract.

exemplar.after:
const fooService = registerService("FooService", { create: createFoo }, { contract: FooServiceContract });
serviceBus.expose(fooService);

records.name: Space-Based Architecture
records.definition: A convention of holding working state in a replicated in-memory space, so no central database limits scaling.
detected_by: single datastore as the scaling limit

exemplar.after:
const foo = await fooSpace.read(id);
fooSpace.on("write", replicateToPeers);
